name: InvokeTerminateHandler
evidence: calls the terminate hook D_00278048 and never returns (exception.cpp)

name: DefaultUnexpectedHandler
evidence: the first value of the unexpected handler D_00278640: calls InvokeTerminateHandler (exception.cpp)

name: ReplaceTerminateHandler
evidence: stores a new terminate hook in D_00278048 and returns the old one (exception.cpp)

name: ReplaceUnexpectedHandler
evidence: stores a new unexpected handler in D_00278640 and returns the old one (exception.cpp)

name: InvokeUnexpectedHandler
evidence: calls the unexpected handler D_00278640 and never returns (exception.cpp; CheckExceptionSpecification calls it)

name: GetThrownObjectAddress
evidence: returns the thrown object's address: the active exception record's pointer plus 8 (exception.cpp)

name: GetActiveExceptionRecord
evidence: returns the active exception record from the exception context (exception.cpp)

name: BeginCatchHandler
evidence: marks the active exception record as being handled (flag 1), counts the entry in its 64-bit count and returns it (exception.cpp; the compiler calls it on entering a catch)

name: AllocateRuntimeBlockOrTerminate
evidence: allocates a block under the runtime lock and calls InvokeTerminateHandler when that fails (exception.cpp; PushThrownException allocates its record with it)

name: FreeRuntimeBlock
evidence: releases a block through LeaveRuntimeLock (exception.cpp; PopThrownException frees its record and buffer with it)

name: MatchPendingThrowType
evidence: exception record callback: with -1 returns the type match already found; otherwise gets the thrown type from the given function, matches it with MatchThrownType against the record's type and object and remembers a hit (exception.cpp)

name: PushThrownException
evidence: allocates a 0x30-byte exception record holding the thrown object, its type and its destructor, sets MatchPendingThrowType as its callback and links it at the head of the active chain (exception.cpp; the compiler's throw calls it)

name: PopThrownException
evidence: drops one reference of an exception record and, at the last, unlinks it, runs its destructor callback, frees its buffer and the record; terminates when it is not on the chain (exception.cpp)

name: AbandonCatchHandler
evidence: clears the handled flag of the active exception record; terminates when none is active (exception.cpp; the compiler calls it on leaving a handler without catching)

name: CheckExceptionSpecification
evidence: checks the active exception against a list of allowed types: rethrows when one matches, otherwise runs the unexpected handler and rethrows a match or throws the unexpected-exception class, else terminates (exception.cpp)

name: ThrowCastError
evidence: throws the exception a failed cast to a reference raises (exception.cpp)

name: ThrowTypeidError
evidence: throws the exception typeid of a null pointer raises (exception.cpp)

name: HasUncaughtException
evidence: returns 1 when an exception record is active and its handler count is still 0 (exception.cpp)

name: GetExceptionTypeName
evidence: returns the name of the exception's own type information: the text of the exception base class (exception.cpp)

name: DestroyUnexpectedException
evidence: destructor of the class thrown for a violated exception specification: resets its vtable to the base class's and calls the base destructor (exception.cpp)

name: ConstructUnexpectedException
evidence: constructor of the class thrown for a violated exception specification: stores its vtable (exception.cpp)

name: GetTypeInfoOfUnexpectedException
evidence: returns the type information of the class thrown for a violated exception specification, building it on first use (exception.cpp)

name: DestroyExceptionBase
evidence: destructor of the exception base class (exception.cpp)

name: ConstructExceptionBase
evidence: constructor of the exception base class: stores its vtable (exception.cpp)

name: GetTypeInfoOfExceptionBase
evidence: returns the type information of the exception base class, building it on first use (exception.cpp)
